profile.subtitleJa: 神殿の回廊名に現れる人物
profile.summaryJa: 使徒言行録では「ソロモンの回廊」という場所名に現れます。ペトロが神殿で人々に語りかけた場面に、その名が記されています。

facts.textJa: 使徒言行録は、使徒たちがソロモンの回廊に集まっていたと記します。
ステパノはソロモンが神のための家を建てたと語ります。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
But Solomon built him a house.
